units.source_text: 尽管如此，联结我俩的心弦忽然断了……

en.t: Even so, the heartstring that bound the two of us suddenly snapped...

units.source_text: 这是真的，钢琴的B音却回响着小提琴的B音。

en.t: It was true, yet the piano's B note echoed the violin's B note.

units.source_text: 灵魂相通也是这般光景吧。

en.t: Perhaps this is what it looks like when souls communicate with each other.

units.source_text: 你的死讯，我连听说都没有听说过，可能是你，也可能是我，反正有一方灵魂的接收器发生了故障。

en.t: I had not even heard the news of your death; perhaps it was you, perhaps it was I, but in any case one of our souls' receivers had broken down.
